title: How to Shorten a Gas Pipe to Fit an Oven

locations.name: Basement area underneath the kitchen (explicit)
locations.basis: Transcript explicitly states: 'we're down in your basement underneath the kitchen.'

summary: This Old House demonstrates shortening a gas supply line so a new convection-enabled oven can sit flush against a wall. The host identifies the lack of a shutoff at the appliance branch, demonstrates shutting off the main gas, safely disconnecting the stove, selecting a pre-cut gas pipe replacement, threading and sealing the joint with pipe dope, and reattaching the line while ensuring space for the stove’s flexible supply. After reassembly, the line is purged and tested with a soap solution for leaks. The segment emphasizes safety, noting that this work should be performed by a licensed professional and that full-house gas shutdown may be required during the procedure.
topics: Gas shut-off valve at appliance (code requirement)
Missing shut-off valve on appliance branch
Shutting off the main gas supply
Applying pipe dope to gas fittings
Pipe alignment to facilitate access to the shut-off
Using a drop cloth to protect surfaces
Purge of individual gas lines after shutdown

sections.title: Assessing space behind the stove and planning the pipe modification
concepts: space required for newer stove features (e.g., convection oven)
sections.description: Identify a roughly four-inch gap behind the new stove and plan to shorten the gas pipe so the appliance can sit flush, taking into account additional space consumed by features like convection systems.

sections.title: Locate shut-offs and safety warning
concepts: branch shut-offs on the main line
absence of a dedicated shut-off valve at the stove branch
sections.description: The team identifies that the stove branch lacks an individual shut-off valve, highlighting the need to shut off the main gas supply and stressing that gas work should be performed by a licensed professional.

sections.title: Shut off the gas and remove the stove
concepts: disconnecting the stove from the gas line
use of drop cloth and careful maneuvering
sections.description: Main gas shut-off is turned to isolate the system, the stove is carefully moved out, and the existing gas connection is detached under safe handling conditions.

sections.title: Assess clearance and plan the pipe replacement
concepts: marking required space for the new shut-off and pipe
sections.description: A clearance measurement is taken; a witness mark is placed to confirm the available height, ensuring enough room for the new pipe and the retrofitted shut-off.

sections.title: Select and prepare the replacement pipe
sections.description: A six-inch pre-cut gas pipe segment is chosen from a professional tray of fittings. The team explains that shorter pieces are typically pre-cut and threaded in the field when needed.

sections.title: Disassemble and prep fittings with pipe dope
concepts: application of pipe dope on threaded joints
sections.description: The existing connection is broken, and pipe dope is applied to the new pipe threads to ensure a proper seal.

sections.title: Thread and seat the new pipe into place
concepts: threading new pipe into the fitting
ensuring threads engage below floor level
sections.description: The replacement pipe is threaded and advanced until the threads below the floor are engaged, with attention to entering the shut-off area parallel to the wall for wrench access.

sections.title: Reconnect and prepare for test
concepts: returning stove to position and removing drop cloth
sections.description: The pipe is brought to the correct position, the connection is reassembled, and the stove is moved back toward the wall; the drop cloth is removed in preparation for gas restoration.

sections.title: Leak test and system purge after re-energizing the line
concepts: purging each line to appliances after a full-house shutdown
sections.description: Gas is turned back on and a soap-solution test is performed to check for leaks. The presenter notes purging each appliance line to ensure the system operates safely after the main shutdown.
